تشترون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرُونَ (taštarūna) /taʃ.ta.ruː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
# تُشْتَرَوْنَ (tuštarawna) /tuʃ.ta.raw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَى (ištarā)
